name: claude-mods
description: Make Claude Code look and feel better

plugins.name: glamour-dark
plugins.description: Draws the model's text replies with charmbracelet/glamour's default dark style

plugins.name: tool-lines
plugins.description: Draws each tool call as one compact 'tool_call: Tool(input) - meta' line and hides its result block

plugins.name: tool-dots
plugins.description: Collapses each run of consecutive tool calls into one 'dots tool_call: Tool ×n' line with no arguments
